            else:
                expires_str = str(expires)
            lines.append(f'   This vulnerability is being ignored until {expires_str}. See your configurations.')

    else:

        lines.append(f'-> Vulnerability may be present given that your {pkg.name} install specifier is')

    else:

    if cve:

        cvssv2 = cve.get('cvssv2', {})

            score = cvssv3.get('base_score', 'N/A')
            impact = cvssv3.get('impact_score', 'N/A')
            vector = cvssv3.get('vector_string', '')
            lines.append(f'   {vuln.get("advisory", "bla")} is {severity} SEVERITY => CVSS v3, BASE SCORE {score}, IMPACT')
            lines.append(f'   SCORE {impact}, VECTOR STRING {vector}')
        
        if cvssv2:
            score = cvssv2.get('base_score', 'N/A')
            impact = cvssv2.get('impact_score', 'N/A')
            vector = cvssv2.get('vector_string', '')
            lines.append(f'   CVSS v2, BASE SCORE {score}, IMPACT SCORE {impact}, VECTOR STRING')
            lines.append(f'   {vector}')
    
    if not is_pinned:
        lines.append('   This vulnerability is present in your install specifier range.')
        lines.append('   To learn more about reporting these, specifier range handling, and')
        lines.append('   options for scanning unpinned packages visit')
        lines.append('   https://docs.pyup.io/docs/safety-range-specs')
    
    lines.append('   For more information about this vulnerability, visit')
    lines.append(f'   {vuln.get("more_info_url", "https://pyup.io")}')
    lines.append('   To ignore this vulnerability, use PyUp vulnerability id ' + vuln.get("vulnerability_id", "N/A") + ' in')
    lines.append('   safety\'s ignore command-line argument or add the ignore to your safety')
    lines.append('   policy file.')
    
    output = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
    
    if only_text:
        output = click.unstyle(output)
    
    return output
